note: Where the original DeHub token's trading tax went, from launch in August 2021 to the last tax payout in March 2023. Traced once from BNB Smart Chain; every figure is valued in USD at that day's Binance BNBUSDT close and can be re-checked on BscScan.

burned.method: Every BuybackDone event on the token: the BNB the contract spent buying DeHub from the PancakeSwap pair, and the tokens that pair sent to the burn address in the same transaction.

shared.method: Every ClaimedBNBRewards (holders) and SentBNBRewards (stakers) event on the rewards contract, totalled per day. The contract's own totalClaimed counter agrees. A further 1.40 BNB was claimed straight from the token in its first two weeks, before the rewards contract existed; the token records only a running total for those, so they are not in the daily figures.
